summary: A static inline message that stays on screen and conveys its type through a variant icon, colour and screen-reader text.
pitfalls: Message is not a live region. When showing one dynamically, Carbon recommends moving focus to it through a ref only for error messages, and placing other variants inside an aria-live region that is present in the DOM on page load.
onDismiss only renders the close button and reports the event; hide the message by setting open to false or unmounting it.
Do not use variant="neutral"; it is deprecated and will be removed, although its type does not mark it as deprecated.

examples.description: Focus a newly shown error message, announce a success message through a persistent aria-live region, and dismiss both by controlling open.
